title: Power of Two
contract: Return whether signed int n is a positive power of two.
brute: if(n<=0)return false;while(n%2==0){n/=2;emit("Divide by two while even","remaining",n);}return n==1;
optimal: emit("A positive power of two has exactly one set bit","n",n,"n AND n-1",n&(n-1));return n>0&&(n&(n-1))==0;
reasoning: Repeatedly divide an even positive value by two and accept only if it reaches one.
Subtracting one flips the lowest set bit and every lower zero bit.
AND with n clears that lowest set bit. The result is zero exactly for one-set-bit positive values; the explicit positivity check rejects zero and Integer.MIN_VALUE.
